purpose: Define the school-neutral engine boundary after pure-helper extraction, without changing Waseda production behavior or replacing Rikkyo's existing FSRS/storage architecture.
principles: The common engine must not own a school's storage key, database name, cloud endpoint, app id, export format, branding, score-band names, UI copy, or migration rules.
Scheduler strategy is injected. Waseda's current forgetting-curve model and Rikkyo's FSRS-6 model are separate valid adapter implementations; neither scheduler is silently reinterpreted as the other.
Item identity is supplied by the school adapter and remains stable. The common engine must not rewrite Waseda vocabulary ids or Rikkyo rik-* stable ids.

Question and planning behavior may share orchestration, but school-specific modes, score bands, study-layer meanings, priority policy, challenge policy and retry spacing remain adapter policy until explicitly normalized.
Persistence and cloud synchronization are separate boundaries from learning-policy extraction.
UI explanation strings remain outside the common engine.

engineOwns: generic queue traversal orchestration once school state has been adapted

firstRuntimeBoundary.name: memory-scheduler-policy-adapter
scope: memory-related part of the v7.6 schedulerScore override
implementationOrder: Introduce a Waseda memory-policy adapter that returns the exact current Waseda values and does not change persistence.
Make the current Waseda memory runtime delegate to that adapter while preserving function outputs and state writes.
Run branch-head and synthetic-merge two-pass existing-user parity and ownership gates.
Define the common scheduler-adapter surface around opaque scheduler state.
Map Rikkyo FSRS-6 to that surface without changing its Card state, stages, learning steps or desired retention.
forbiddenFirstStep: moving v76TargetRetention directly into the common engine with S-priority logic
making Waseda use ts-fsrs during this boundary step
changing Waseda schemaVersion or localStorage keys
changing Rikkyo stableId x skillKey identity

secondRuntimeBoundary.name: memory-priority-scoring-policy-adapter
scope: memory retrievability boost inside the v7.6 schedulerScore override
30-day exam urgency and its S-priority/weak-item weights
memory-gap exam urgency inside the v7.6 schedulerScore override
memory retrievability boost inside the v7.6 v75ChallengeScore override
implementationOrder: Keep the exact current scoring constants and predicates in the Waseda memory-policy adapter; do not move them into the common engine.
Make the v7.6 schedulerScore and v75ChallengeScore overrides delegate only their memory/exam additions to the Waseda adapter while preserving the original base scores and evaluation order.
Run exact branch-head and synthetic-merge two-pass existing-user parity, ownership, deterministic assembly and cloud guards.
Only after this boundary is green, continue to the Waseda planning-policy boundary.
forbiddenSecondStep: moving S-priority, weak-item, exam-window or challenge score constants into the common engine
changing v76ExamDaysLeft behavior or examDate persistence
changing the base schedulerScore or base v75ChallengeScore behavior
changing Waseda storage, stable ids, progress-sync.js or UI copy
changing Rikkyo FSRS, stableId x skillKey state, planning lanes or persistence

thirdRuntimeBoundary.name: session-planning-policy-adapter
implementationOrder: Freeze the exact current Waseda planning inputs, outputs, score constants, reason strings and retry-spacing semantics in a reviewed contract.
Introduce a Waseda planning-policy adapter without changing the session object, queue order or learner-visible reason text.
Delegate one planning function group at a time and run exact-head plus synthetic-merge two-pass parity after each reviewed boundary.
Only after Waseda planning policy is isolated may generic planning orchestration move into the common engine.
forbiddenThirdStep: putting mode 75, S/A/B/C, challenge/diagnostic layer meanings or Japanese reason text into the common engine
changing retry spacing or queue order while extracting policy
